      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one
            of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'. Stored and returned, and used to derive
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat single line for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space
            and the normalized addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when a non-blank value is
            supplied. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored/returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space; stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region
            table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Validated only when present; stored
            and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a single leading
            '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is stored and returned, and is used to derive
            the owner's ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time hint that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode) and drives
            only the derived householdId, household size and membership-level cap. It no
            longer affects duplicate detection, which is now keyed solely on the
            identityKey (SHA-256 of normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)):
            an exact identityKey match is rejected 409, while a near match
            (same soundex(lastName) and postcode, different identityKey) is flagged as a
            possible duplicate. It does not create the household link; the shared
            householdId is always derived deterministically. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, derived at response
                time as '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when
                the owner has no id. Not persisted.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at response time as the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR Who'), or
                just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region); FY is the two-digit last two
                digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                Assigned at creation; unifies the former customerCode and membershipNumber
                and subsumes the standalone checkDigit.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273F9A1C7E4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                FY segment of the memberId (the last two digits of the fiscal year, the
                calendar year in which it ends, of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate). The fiscal year starts on 1 July. Derived at response
                time; not persisted.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case
                hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized lastName concatenated
                with '|' and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and postcode
                automatically share it, regardless of creation order. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: '9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived at response time. Starts at 0,
                plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2
                for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for tenure of more than one
                elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at response time from the REGION prefix of
                the memberId (the leading run of letters before the two-digit fiscal
                year), or 'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived at response time from the
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at response time. 'true' when more than 80 owners have
                already been created on this owner's registration day, otherwise
                'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Derived at response time. 'true' when the owner's city already holds
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the hard capacity
                limit of 50, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at response time.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived at response time as '<TIER>_<AREA>' -
                one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a
                known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Not persisted.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed at response time over the
                digits contained in the customerCode. Not persisted.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at response time from birthDate
                against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18
                to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when the owner has no
                birthDate. Not persisted.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned at creation. Flags a suspected (soft) duplicate: an earlier
                non-deleted owner whose soundex(lastName) and postcode both match this
                owner's, but whose identityKey differs (so it is not a hard duplicate).
                An exact identityKey match is rejected 409 instead and never reaches
                this flag.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the earliest earlier owner this owner is a possible
                duplicate of, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false. Assigned
                at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}. The record is retained and still returned by GET
                /api/owners/{id} with this flag 'true'; the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore it. 'false' for a newly
                created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes and
                space-separated (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at response time
                from the raw E.164 'telephone', which is unchanged. Not persisted.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's deterministic identity key: the full lower-case hex
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (an
                absent telephone or email contributes an empty segment; the last
                name is reduced to its Soundex code). This single key drives
                duplicate detection: a create is rejected 409 when a non-deleted
                owner already carries the same identity key. Derived at response
                time and not persisted.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30

        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string

        type:

    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true

            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30

          example: 'Carter'

    Vet:

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object

              title: ID

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object

    PetTypeFields:

    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object

          description: The username
